summary: Quiet kerb beside an open park, homes well back across the road.

best_section.where: East kerb of Baty Street along the grassed park, north of the shrubs

drivers.seclusion: East side is open park; nearest dwellings are apartments 39 m or more away, only a construction site closer.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a car parked at the kerb near 50 m; park edge gives room, narrow lane.
drivers.traffic: Short residential dead-end style street near a main road; light traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the street; a van would blend in.

flags: Narrow lane: tight to pass a parked van
Noise from the main road at the north end
sun_shade: Large trees to the north-east shade the northern end; middle section open to morning sun.
